packageRules.description: ReactLynx, its compiler plugin, Rspeedy and the web runtime must move together and be verified on device; see docs/wiki/dependency-updates.md
Native Lynx SDK and PrimJS releases are coordinated across Android and iOS; ignore nightly/prerelease builds
Rspeedy's TypeScript peer range ends at 6.0.x; the independent docs package may use newer TypeScript
LynxService/Image pins these exact versions in its podspec; upgrade only with the Lynx SDK
Fresco must match the release lynx-service-image is compiled against (2.3.0 for Lynx 4.1.0); Fresco 3 crashes at launch
androidx.core 1.18+ requires API 23; the app supports API 21
Android Gradle Plugin and Kotlin are verified together with the Gradle wrapper
